Name: PC's Tilesheets
Author: PlatinumCats
Description:
[center]A tilesheet mod featuring a collection of my furniture sets.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PsFyPgl.png[/img][line]
Currently includes tilesheets from:

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27047]PC's Rattan Furniture
[/url][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28810]PC's Spirit's Eve Furniture[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33247]PC's Old World Furniture[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33602]PC's Industrial Furniture[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34287]PC's Shabby Chic Furniture[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35529]Victorian Furniture - Swan Set[/url]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/of2ZpLV.png[/img]
[line]
Note for modders:

* Modders are free to use this tilesheet mod, but it must be listed as a requirement.
* Do not include this mod's .png files in your upload.
* If you want to customize any of the assets for a more personal touch, feel free to copy the specific asset into your own tilesheet and edit it there. Keep in mind that you'll still need to use this mod as a requirement, and don't forget to give credit!
* If you've already received permission to use assets from my furniture packs, you're not required to rework your maps or use this tilesheet as a dependency as I know that can be a hassle.
That said, if you choose to include it anyway, it's genuinely appreciated!

[line]


[img]https://i.imgur.com/MPfj3Cv.png[/img]


[/center]
